title: Adjusted EBITDA and non-GAAP reconciliation
prompt:
Prepare the quarter's policy-compliant adjusted EBITDA reconciliation.

Begin with the FY26 tax-provision and EBITDA-definition thread in `Requests/`, including the close-review follow-up. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: identify the current controller-tied workpapers, retain prior versions only for comparison, and resolve source authority from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Several nearby files are earlier working versions or belong to a different reporting purpose. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Recompute the analysis from the shared company sources and do not rely on a deliverable produced by another task.

Reconcile GAAP net income to EBITDA, then assess every proposed adjustment against the board-approved non-GAAP policy. Exclude normal recurring operating costs and uncommitted savings; include only qualifying acquisition, restructuring, or unusual items net of related recoveries. Prevent double counting items already excluded from GAAP EBITDA. Return EBITDA, accepted and rejected adjustments, adjusted EBITDA, margin, and the largest rejected item.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `gaap_net_income`, `ebitda`, `accepted_adjustments`, `rejected_adjustments`, `adjusted_ebitda`, `adjusted_ebitda_margin`, `largest_rejected_item`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
